gloss: silk fabric; silk textile; silk cloth

definitions.gloss: silk fabric; silk textile; silk cloth
definitions.explanation: Fabric woven from silk thread, known for its smooth texture and lustrous appearance. Japan has a long tradition of silk weaving, particularly in Kyoto and other regions.

examples.japanese: {絹織物|きぬおりもの}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{肌触|はだざわ}り→肌触り：06637_hadazawari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Silk fabric feels good against the skin.

examples.english: Much of the silk fabric used in kimono is hand-woven by artisans.

notes:
Japan has centuries of tradition in silk production and weaving. Major silk-weaving regions include {西陣|にしじん} (Nishijin) in Kyoto, known for {西陣織|にしじんおり}, and Kiryu in Gunma.

- ⟦{国産|こくさん}→国産：12017_kokusan⟧{絹織物|きぬおりもの}: domestically produced silk fabric
